messages:
olga: Quick check — for the per-route quota change I'm about to ship, is it acceptable to return both the legacy X-RateLimit-* headers and the new `x-rw-quota-*` headers at the same time? Trying to avoid a big SDK churn.

kai: keep both. SDKs should prefer `x-rw-quota-*` but fall back to X-RateLimit. Backcompat > purity here. :+1:

sam: +1 on keeping both. also we need to confirm semantics: when soft-burst is active, do we still decrement the main bucket immediately or only when burst is drained?

lee: implementation detail: soft-burst will take from the burst bucket first, and main bucket is decremented as normal for steady tokens. So client-visible remaining for main bucket will drop as usual, burst has its own counter.

maria: for clarity, here's the header shape we'd return in staging:
```
X-RateLimit-Limit: 120
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 87
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1710000000
x-rw-quota-bucket: user:12345:/v1/generate:burst=20;window=60
x-rw-quota-burst-remaining: 5
x-rw-quota-main-remaining: 87
```
If SDK sees `x-rw-quota-*` it can surface burst vs main separately.

olga: thanks, that helps. One more: what should clients do on 429? We have mixed guidance across docs. Should we send `Retry-After` as seconds or ms? Also include a machine-parsable body?

kai: we standardized on seconds for `Retry-After` header (integer seconds). Body should be structured minimal JSON: { "error": "rate_limited", "retry_after": 2 }. Keep both.

sam: will SDKs prefer header or body if both present?

lee: prefer header for human-readable quick checks, but SDKs should use the body `retry_after` (float allowed) for precise backoff. header is fallback.

maria: note: we also add `x-rw-quota-hint: "main=87,burst=5"` as a short hint for simple clients. Not a contract for parsing.

olga: perfect. I'll update the API contract doc and add a small sample snippet for client teams.

olga: sample client psuedocode to backoff: 
```
if (resp.status == 429) {
  wait = resp.body?.retry_after ?? parseInt(resp.headers['retry-after'] || '1')
  await sleep(wait * 1000)
  retry()
}
```

kai: tiny nit — publish the header names in lowercase in the doc to reduce confusion for Node libs.

maria: making that change now. I'll also push a staging config that emits both header families for the next 48h rollout.

ops-bot: staging-config: per-route-quota-dual-headers enabled for service=runtime, env=staging

deploy-bot: deploy completed: staging/runtime 2026-03-17T14:12:03Z :white_check_mark:

olga: awesome, thanks everyone. tagging infra owners @kai @lee for monitoring: can we get an alert if burst consumption goes >90% for 5m?

kai: added an alert rule and a dashboard tile. will watch first 6 hours. :eyes:

olga: great — closing the loop, i'll post the updated contract link in #eng-docs after a quick PR.
